PLAY · HOW SOUNDS ARE MADE

Monkey’s Sound Lab

Music time! Tap an instrument, then tap the action that makes its sound.

Tap an instrument, then tap how it makes sound.

The band is playing!

Strike the drum, ring the bell, pluck the guitar — three ways to make sound!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Every sound is something moving — shaking, hitting, plucking. Feel it for real: put a hand on a drum while it plays, and watch guitar strings blur.
